categories.main_business_segments: Yantai Zhenghai Bio-Tech Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the research, development, production, and sales of biological regenerative materials. Their product portfolio includes Class III implantable medical devices such as oral repair membranes, absorbable and non-absorbable dura mater patches, skin repair membranes, bone repair materials, active biological bone, light-curing composite resin, self-etch adhesives, pit and fissure sealants, phosphoric acid etchants, and surgical sponges. These products serve clinical needs in oral and maxillofacial surgery, neurosurgery, orthopedics, dermatology, and otolaryngology.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary technologies in decellularization, scaffold biomaterials with natural or biomimetic structures, active factor induction, and stem cell technology. They employ advanced manufacturing methods including 3D printing and high-temperature sintering for calcium silicate bioceramic bone repair materials. Their R&D integrates additive manufacturing, genetic engineering, and synthetic biology to develop innovative regenerative medical products. Quality management follows stringent lifecycle controls, including ISO 13485 and ISO 9001 certifications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include hospitals and medical institutions across China, covering public and private sectors. Their products are widely used by clinical departments such as oral and maxillofacial surgery, neurosurgery, orthopedics, dermatology, and ENT. The company maintains a broad dealer network with over 1,410 distributors nationwide, serving more than 10,000 clinical institutions and millions of patients. Major sales are driven by oral repair membranes and dura mater products, with growing market penetration in bone repair materials.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with sales distributed across all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities. Key regional markets include East China, North China, South China, Southwest, Northeast, and Northwest China. The company has successfully participated in provincial and inter-provincial centralized procurement alliances, such as the Shaanxi provincial alliance covering six provinces, Hebei, Shandong, and Tianjin. There is no significant overseas operation reported.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yantai Zhenghai Bio-Tech functions mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the medical device supply chain. It undertakes in-house R&D, manufacturing, and quality control of implantable medical devices and regenerative biomaterials. The company manages raw material procurement with a dynamic supplier evaluation system to ensure stable supply and quality. It distributes products through direct sales and a broad dealer network to end medical institutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in regenerative medicine, focusing on scaffold materials, active biological factors, and seed cell technologies. It pursues high-end product development with emphasis on additive manufacturing, gene engineering, and synthetic biology. R&D efforts include advancing calcium silicate bioceramic bone repair materials, non-absorbable surgical sutures, uterine repair membranes, breast patches, and umbilical cord mesenchymal stem cells. The company maintains strong collaborations with top research institutes and hospitals to accelerate clinical translation and expand its product pipeline.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of Class III medical devices and high-value medical consumables. The company employs a sales model combining direct sales to hospitals and distribution via dealers. Income is recognized upon transfer of control of goods, either at delivery to hospitals or upon product usage confirmation. The company also earns investment income from financial assets and government subsidies, but these are non-recurring and not core to revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Yantai Zhenghai Bio-Tech is among the earliest and leading domestic companies specializing in regenerative medicine and Class III implantable medical devices in China. It holds a strong market position in oral and maxillofacial surgery and neurosurgery with recognized domestic brands. The company faces increasing competition and policy pressures from centralized procurement reforms but leverages its proprietary technologies and broad clinical acceptance to maintain competitive advantages. It is recognized as a national 'specialized and innovative' enterprise and a leader in high-end biomedical materials.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 363.2 million, a 12.19% decrease from 2023, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 134.6 million, down 29.49%. Total assets stood at about RMB 980.1 million with net assets of RMB 888.8 million. Despite short-term revenue decline due to market and policy challenges, the company maintains solid profitability and cash flow. It invests over 10% of revenue annually in R&D, supporting sustained innovation and future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its mission to 'restore the body's self-healing power' through innovative regenerative medical products. Its unique value lies in proprietary technology platforms integrating scaffold materials, active biological factors, and stem cells to provide comprehensive tissue repair solutions. The active biological bone product, combining bone scaffold and recombinant human bone morphogenetic protein-2, is a domestic first, accelerating bone healing effectively. The company’s rigorous quality management, extensive clinical validation, and broad market penetration differentiate it as a trusted supplier of high-quality implantable medical devices.
